heading: Combination with other extensions
text:
### Combination with other extensions [LNOG.2.2]

`logical: false` combines with any other setting. Interactions:

| With `logical: false` and | Effect |
|---|---|
| `realtime: true` | TMS term eliminated from T_wcet. Retraction path is O(1) per fact. See [LNOG.5.2]. |
| `linear_scan: false` | Multi-pattern rules banned (consequence of LNLS.3.3 + LNOG.3). See [LNOG.6]. |
| `realtime: true`, `linear_scan: false` | Tightest possible constraint: single-pattern rules only, all operations O(1) in N_max. |
| `dynamic_ttl: true` | Allowed; `dynamic_ttl` heap semantics apply to TTL schemas normally. |

The rows with `realtime: true` are deferred with that capability, and the
compiler refuses them in this edition ([LCAP.2.1.5]).
